name: PM-KISAN Samman Nidhi
description: Direct income support of ₹6,000 per year to farmer families, paid in three equal installments.
benefits: ₹6,000 per year (₹2,000 every 4 months) directly to bank account

name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana – Gramin (PMAY-G)
description: Financial assistance for construction of pucca houses for rural poor who are houseless or living in kutcha/dilapidated houses.
benefits: ₹1,20,000 in plains and ₹1,30,000 in hilly/difficult areas for house construction

name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana – Urban (PMAY-U)
description: Affordable housing for urban poor through interest subsidy on home loans and direct assistance.
benefits: Interest subsidy of 6.5% on home loans up to ₹6 lakh for EWS/LIG; up to 4% for MIG
documents_required: Affidavit of not owning a pucca house

name: Ayushman Bharat – Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (PM-JAY)
name_hi: आयुष्मान भारत – प्रधानमंत्री जन आरोग्य योजना
description: Health insurance of ₹5 lakh per family per year for secondary and tertiary hospitalisation.
benefits: ₹5,00,000 health cover per family per year at empanelled hospitals. Covers 1,950+ procedures.

name: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana (PMUY)
description: Free LPG connection to women from BPL households to replace unclean cooking fuel.
benefits: Free LPG connection with a financial support of ₹1,600 per connection. First refill and stove free.

name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana (SSY)
description: Government-backed savings scheme for the girl child with high interest rate and tax benefits.
benefits: Interest rate ~8.2% p.a. (government-set). Tax-free maturity. Min deposit ₹250/year, max ₹1,50,000/year.

name: Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana (PMMY)
description: Collateral-free loans up to ₹10 lakh for micro and small enterprises.
benefits: Shishu: up to ₹50,000 | Kishore: ₹50,001 to ₹5,00,000 | Tarun: ₹5,00,001 to ₹10,00,000. No collateral required.

name: Atal Pension Yojana (APY)
description: Guaranteed pension of ₹1,000 to ₹5,000 per month after age 60 for unorganised sector workers.
benefits: Monthly pension of ₹1,000 to ₹5,000 after age 60. Government co-contributes 50% of premium for 5 years (for non-taxpayers who joined before 31 March 2016).
documents_required: Mobile number linked to bank account
application_url: Any bank branch or via net banking

name: PM Vishwakarma
description: End-to-end support for traditional artisans and craftworkers through skills, tools, credit, and market access.
ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small & Medium Enterprises
benefits: Skills training with ₹500/day stipend. Toolkit incentive up to ₹15,000. Collateral-free loans: ₹1 lakh (Stage 1) + ₹2 lakh (Stage 2) at 5% interest. Digital incentives and marketing support.
documents_required: Proof of artisan trade (self-declaration / panchayat certificate)

name: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme (IGNOAPS)
name_hi: इंदिरा गांधी राष्ट्रीय वृद्धावस्था पेंशन योजना
description: Monthly pension for BPL senior citizens aged 60 and above.
benefits: ₹200/month (age 60-79) + state top-up. ₹500/month (age 80+). Many states add ₹300-₹2,000 on top.

name: Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana (PMMVY)
description: Cash incentive for pregnant women and lactating mothers for the first living child.
benefits: ₹5,000 in three installments for the first child. ₹6,000 for second child if it is a girl.

name: Post-Matric Scholarship for SC/ST/OBC/Minority Students
name_hi: एससी/एसटी/ओबीसी/अल्पसंख्यक छात्रों के लिए पोस्ट-मैट्रिक छात्रवृत्ति
description: Scholarships for students from disadvantaged communities pursuing post-matriculation education.
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice / Ministry of Tribal Affairs / Ministry of Minority Affairs
benefits: Covers tuition fees, maintenance allowance, and other expenses. Amount varies by course and category.

name: PM Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi (PM SVANidhi)
description: Working capital loan for street vendors to resume livelihood.
benefits: ₹10,000 (1st loan) → ₹20,000 (2nd loan) → ₹50,000 (3rd loan). 7% interest subsidy. Cashback incentive for digital transactions.
documents_required: Vending certificate / Letter of recommendation from ULB

name: Pradhan Mantri Garib Kalyan Anna Yojana (PMGKAY)
description: Free foodgrain distribution to priority households and Antyodaya families under the National Food Security Act.
ministry: Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food & Public Distribution
benefits: 5 kg free foodgrain per person per month for priority households. 35 kg per family for Antyodaya (AAY) households.
documents_required: Family members list on ration card

name: Indira Gandhi National Widow Pension Scheme (IGNWPS)
name_hi: इंदिरा गांधी राष्ट्रीय विधवा पेंशन योजना
description: Monthly pension for widows from BPL families aged 40-79.
benefits: ₹300/month from central government + state top-up (varies by state, total often ₹1,000-₹2,500/month).
